description.content:
Returns suggestions for a given query. Call this while the user is typing to help the user find what they're looking for. The suggestions are of two types: - suggestions for search queries that are related to the current query - suggestions for categories that are related to the current query Example response: 
{
  "suggestions_request_id": "c6fa5efd-1bde-43a8-9ac4-434605f53024",
  "suggestions": [
    {
      "type": "query",
      "title": "red hat",
      "suggestions_result_id": "60c54958-8f2d-4ffd-a343-d316e79593b8"
    },
    {
      "category_id": "sweaters-hoodies",
      "title": "Sweaters & Hoodies",
      "page_url": "https://foobar.com/sweaters-hoodies",
      "type": "category",
      "suggestions_result_id": "b11ee4a9-0d95-4559-b1fa-76479ca3e3ea"
    }
  ]
}

Returns recommendations for products related to the search query. Note that this
endpoint takes the same request body as the `/v2/search/results` endpoint, excluding
the pagination parameters. It should be called once the user has exhausted the
search results for their query and the recommended products are typically shown
below the search results.
